endorsements.name: Hoang Bao
endorsements.label: Building Trust by Design
endorsements.description: The talk will focus on how to engender users trust in consumer products by integrating privacy, safety, and security elements in the product design process. Key points include: Privacy and Safety by Design should be an integral part of the online and mobile product development processes. A product should strive to find that sweet spot of giving consumers meaningful notice and controls over their data without limiting the core functionality of the product. Security is a requisite for privacy.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2016
